name: timeclock
description: Employee-friendly time clock with immutable punches, biweekly time sheets, and correction requests.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @timeclock/core && npm run build --workspace @timeclock/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @timeclock/core && npm run test --workspace @timeclock/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @timeclock/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @timeclock/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @timeclock/web && npm run lint --workspace @timeclock/android
